items.summary: Institutional investor Soros Fund Management has fully exited its position in lululemon athletica (NasdaqGS:LULU), removing a source of prior institutional support for the stock. The move comes as sentiment on Lululemon weakens alongside broader pressure on the activewear sector, with peers such as Nike and On Holding also facing headwinds.
